why_this_file_exists: MTEB's TaskResult JSON records dataset_revision but not the model; MTEB keeps model identity only in its cache directory layout. This sidecar records which configuration produced the artifact.

model_meta.name: debug907/gte-modernbert-base-raw
model_meta.similarity_fn_name: cosine (dot product of the 769-d vectors: cosine of the 768-d embeddings minus beta*hub)

configuration.document_view: raw (the document as given, ends stripped as MTEB passes it; no code view, no 512-word cut)

hubness_correction.hub: mean cosine of d to its k nearest AppsRetrieval TRAINING queries; a document's own training queries excluded; test queries never used
hubness_correction.inside_mteb: one appended dimension: +1 for queries, -beta*hub(d) for documents (encoder.py hub_table)
